cache: L1 Data 48K shared 0; L1 Instruction 32K shared 0; L2 Unified 2048K shared 0; L3 Unified 327680K shared 0-3
latency_ms_is: median. raw_ms_min and raw_ms_max are the sample range. Two untimed calls run first. Sampling stops at 5 samples once accumulated sample time reaches 350 ms, otherwise at 25 samples.
qk_pv_flops_note: 4 * head_dim * seq * queries. QK and PV only; exp and the horizontal add are omitted. scope=head uses one KV head and its GQA group. scope=model and scope=model_heads use every query head in every layer.
